title: What's New in Kotlin Jump
tagline: A label inside a template stays text
summary: A name written in a quoted literal nested inside a template expression was counted as a reference. Find Usages, occurrence highlighting and rename now leave it alone.

highlights.title: Nested strings stay text
highlights.description: Inside a template expression you are back in code, so a quoted literal written there is text again, and its words are no longer treated as references.

sections.heading: Fixes
bullets: A name inside a quoted literal nested in a template expression is text, not a reference. The scan used to keep counting code past the opening quote, so Find Usages reported an extra hit, the usage count on the lens was off by one, and a rename would have rewritten the label.
Found by comparing what occurrence highlighting and Find Usages answer about the same position, across every raw string of a real 3187 file Kotlin project.
